leadText: Panic at the Cherry Blossom Festival (Japanese: お花見で大パニック Panic at the Cherry Blossom Festival) is the 10th chapter of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga.
plainText:
Panic at the Cherry Blossom Festival (Japanese: お花見で大パニック Panic at the Cherry Blossom Festival) is the 10th chapter of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga.

==Plot==
 
It is time for a cherry blossom festival in Hazel's town. She attends with Grandpa, Coconut, Almond, and the Pokémon. Grandpa offers and a drink of sake, but Hazel stops him, insisting that the Pokémon should not drink alcoholic beverages. She offers them instead, however, the effect of the amazake on the Pokémon is the same as if a human had drank sake. As they are discovering that amazake gets Pokémon drunk, they discover a very drunk and violent that is causing trouble. Dodrio's cousin, , apologises for his behavior.

Coconut brings out a sleeping potion to try to sedate Dodrio, but it turns out to be a firecracker instead, which explodes on . , the only Pokémon that didn't get drunk, tries to attack Dodrio with his , however, he is unable to defeat Dodrio. Clefairy decides to fight instead, despite still being drunk from the amazake. He too is defeated by Dodrio's .

Finally, manages to put everyone to sleep with her attack and the cherry blossom festival is cancelled. The entire group sleeps outside, and in the morning all the Pokémon are hungover and all of the humans catch colds.

==Major events==
Hazel and her friends attend a cherry blossom festival.

In the English translation, the was changed to apple cider. This change was likely made as amazake is not a common drink in the English-speaking world.
